# Project Sync/Board Management Saved Reply

Hi @username,

There was an issue syncing items to GitHub Projects or with board automation.

**Troubleshooting steps:**

- Ensure the item is linked to the correct project/board
- Review automation rules in the project settings
- Manually sync or move items if automation failed

- [GitHub Projects Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/issues/organizing-your-work-with-projects)
